main_text.p: tione componantur.' 1 Cor. 14.29. et 32. prophetarum spiritus tantum prophetis subjici: neque per prophetas intelligi omnes in universum Christianos, sed tantum illos, qui ex legitima vocatione ecclesiam docent. Idq; liquere ex 1 Cor. 12.29. Num omnes prophetae? &. Atqui antea edocti sumus ex Joh. 5. 39. 1 Thess. 5. 21. & 1. Joh. 4. 1. omnibus & singulis fidelibus competere judicium de prophetis & rebus fidei. itaque sciendum est, judicium de rebus fidei (subordinatum videlicet: nam supremum est solius Spiritus S.) esse privatum aut publicum. Privatum competit omnibus & singulis credentibus: testibus praedictis scripturae S. locis, quibus addeillud Christi Johan. 10. 3. & seq. oves vocem ejus (Christi pastoris ovium) audiunt. Item oves eum sequuntur: quia norunt vocem ejus; alienum autem nequaquam sequentur, sed fugient ab eo: quia non norunt vocem alienorum. page.notes: The page opens mid-paragraph, so the first paragraph is a continuation (cont="true") and is left open at the end, since the line ends with the hyphenated "tan-". Some reference letters are doubtful: "Johan." may be "Joh.", and the catchword "tum," at the lower right is uncertain. The text is printed in italic for the marginal-style references and quotations inside the column; these are kept in the column, not as notes. The word "s" appears as "S." in the printed "Spiritus S." and "scripturae S."; these are transcribed as S. The line "tantùm illos" has a superscript-style mark that could not be confirmed.
